Header: Spodoptera litura and S. exigua In sinhala:Lunu dalambuwa, In Tamil: Vengaya thalkothi pulu

Monitoring: Regular observation for caterpillars at base of the plant and inside leaves.
Observe for whitening or chlorotic lesions on leaves and dried leaves
Direct Control: Removal of egg masses and caterpillars
Restrictions: Insecticide should be applied at the first sign of infestation
Repeated application may lead to resistance buildup
